I've recorded dozens of product demos and the post-production always takes 5x longer than the actual recording. Auto-zoom into the area of activity is the one feature that would save the most time — manually adding zoom keyframes in DaVinci Resolve is the most tedious part of any tutorial video.

The "cinematic out of the box, no post-production" claim is bold but that's exactly what the market needs. Screen recordings are the most common video type for SaaS demos and tutorials, yet they look amateurish 90% of the time. A tool that produces something polished enough for a Product Hunt launch video or YouTube tutorial without touching a video editor would be incredibly valuable. No watermark in beta is a smart move.

Title: Velo: Professionally edited demos presented by your AI avatar | Product Hunt
# Velo. ## Professionally edited demos presented by your AI avatar. ## Professionally edited demos presented by your AI avatar. Are your product demos keeping up? But every time I need to actually show someone what I made, I'm back to screen recording, messing up, re-recording, and spending way more time than I'd like to admit on something that should be simple. Where does a demo actually matter most for you - selling, onboarding, getting feedback, something else? ### Productivity. ### Trending products. I'm Ajay, co-founder and CTO at Velo, and we're thrilled to launch Velo on PH for the first time! **Why did we build Velo?**. Despite all the demo tools that exist today, it still took me five takes and ninety minutes to record a simple product walkthrough. I tried the AI screen recorders, AI voiceovers, and editors. Every team faces this, whether it's sales demos, product walkthroughs, feature launches, or onboarding videos. **Velo changes this process completely.**. It creates scripted, professionally edited product demos, either from a recording you already have or one our browser agent captures for you. **Browser agent:** Velo runs inside your browser, watches your clicks, your flow, your intent, and builds the demo for you. You don't record yourself. **Raw to polished:** Upload a Zoom call, Loom video, or screen recording. Velo writes a new script from scratch, syncs the audio and visuals, and delivers a demo worth sharing. **Multiple asset input:** Paste a URL or upload files (PPT, PNG, PDF, MOV, MP4), and Velo creates a demo out of it. **Script generation:** Velo writes the script based on your product flow. **In-built editor**: Beautify your product demos by adding zooms, cursor shapes, highlights, intro cards, AI-Avatar, background music, and more. **Sales teams:** Ship prospect-ready demos without twelve takes and a half-day of editing. **Product marketers:** Launch features with polished walkthroughs in minutes, not days. **Founders:** Be the face of your product without sitting in front of a camera. **CS and enablement teams:** Build onboarding flows, training demos, and how-to videos fast. On this launch day, I want to show my gratitude for taking your time and checking out Velo.
